title: Connect to your sync server
notice: All your devices use the same sync server. Your encrypted vault file remains available locally and offline.
routeLabel: All devices synchronize through the central server
serverHint: Enter your server using HTTPS. In this development prototype, HTTP is only allowed for 127.0.0.1 or ::1. Never put vault passwords or keys in the URL.
readyHint: This server stores encrypted versions for all your devices. Other PCs do not need to be online when synchronizing. The server receives no decryption keys.

errors.unavailable: This server does not support password sign-in, or the development prototype is unavailable.
errors.invalid: The input is invalid. Use your sync server's base URL without credentials, query parameters or a path.
errors.stale: This setup is no longer current. Close and reopen the dialog.
errors.mismatch: Device verification failed. No data was shared.
errors.expired: Authorization has expired. Start setup again.
errors.failed: Setup could not be completed. Your local vault data was not changed.
errors.connection: The server could not be confirmed. Check the URL, HTTPS certificate and availability of the Shellherd sync service. Redirects are rejected.
errors.syncLocked: Open and unlock your vault to synchronize. Close any open vault before downloading for the first time.
errors.syncChanged: The vault changed locally or externally during synchronization. Retry; those changes were not overwritten.
errors.syncHistory: Encrypted history is incomplete or invalid. The local vault will not be overwritten.
errors.syncWrongVault: Vault password, vault identity or encryption does not match. No local data was overwritten.
errors.syncRecovery: A local write did not complete unambiguously. Back up the vault and encrypted sync state and inspect recovery.
errors.syncLimit: The supported size, history or encryption profile limit was exceeded. The local vault is preserved.
errors.syncConflict: The versions require explicit conflict resolution. Existing variants are preserved.
errors.syncBindings: Configure device-specific key and file paths locally.

passwordHint: For server sign-in only. Use a different password from your vault password.
manualNotice: Synchronization starts when you click. An encrypted backup is created before local changes are applied. New or changed connections may need local approval.
localVaultHint: To load the vault on this device: enter your vault password. It is used only locally for decryption and never sent to the server. Then choose a new local file. Imported connections start disabled.
bindingsNeeded: The received version needs local key or kubeconfig paths. The local vault remains unchanged.
conflictsKept: Synchronization has conflicts. Both versions remain encrypted; your local vault has not been overwritten.
approvalsNeeded: New or changed connections need local approval before use.
keepLocalHint: This choice keeps local connection settings for all reported connection conflicts. Independent server changes are still applied. Other versions remain in encrypted history.
keepLocal: Keep my connection settings for conflicts
